evaluation_system_002.answer: California Standards for the Teaching Profession (CSTP)
evaluation_system_002.evidence: site administration shall primarily assist unit members in meeting the California Standards for the Teaching Profession (CSTP).

evaluation_observation_count_003.answer: No more than two (2) formal observations per evaluation
evaluation_observation_count_003.evidence: Unit members shall have no more than two (2) formal observations per each evaluation.

evaluation_observation_duration_004.evidence: Formal classroom observations shall last for at least fifteen (15) minutes and no more than sixty (60) minutes.

evaluation_ratings_005.evidence: A Standard is identified as “unsatisfactory” if it has three (3) or more elements marked as “Below Standard”.
